claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: KB-R7943 at 2.5 uM is a weak, non-selective inhibitor of Na+/Ca2+ exchange and TRPC channels with no expected potent cytotoxic mechanism in cancer cell lines, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
